funnel.title: Companies come to you
funnel.lead: Working with companies on your own means hunting for them, sending your media kit and waiting for replies, again and again. Here companies post what they need, and briefs that fit you show up in your feed.

points.budget: Every brief shows the budget or the barter up front.
points.offers: Post your services and let companies send you requests.

briefs.title: Apply to briefs

offer.title: 1 Reels about your product

offer.request: A coffee shop wants to work with you

commission.title: No commission
commission.body: Whatever you agree with a company is yours. We don’t take a cut.

private.title: Your contacts stay private
private.body: A company sees how to reach you only after it accepts you.

choice.title: You decide
choice.body: Withdraw an application before it’s accepted, or decline any request you don’t like.

followers.q: How many followers do I need?
followers.a: There’s no fixed minimum. Each company sets its own in the brief, and your feed shows only the briefs you qualify for.

pay.a: The company pays you directly, in money or barter, as the brief says. Payments don’t go through briefluence, and we take no commission.

plans.q: What’s the difference between Basic and Pro?
plans.a: Every new influencer gets 30 days of Pro for free. After that Basic stays free, with a limit on applications and live service cards. Pro has no limits.

review.q: Why do you check my profile and accounts?
review.a: So companies can trust what they see. We look at every profile and every added account before it counts. Accounts must be public. This keeps fake accounts out.

noReply.q: What if a company doesn’t reply?
noReply.a: You see when a company opens your application. If nothing happens, you can withdraw it any time before it’s accepted and focus on other briefs.
